label: live-alias-mutation
signature: rejected: Live-alias mutation in `target`: mutating `b` in place while alias `a` is still observed afterward. LemmaScript models arrays, maps, sets, and records as immutable values, so mutating `b` would not update `a` (clone explicitly or mutate through a single live binding). (aliasing/live-alias-mutation)
detail: Live-alias mutation in `target`: mutating `b` in place while alias `a` is still observed afterward. LemmaScript models arrays, maps, sets, and records as immutable values, so mutating `b` would not update `a` (clone explicitly or mutate through a single live binding).
